newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks open broadly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks open broadly higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened broadly higher on Monday, continuing their rebound from Friday's early sell-off.
The Dow industrials rose 35 points to 6,417 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite was up 11 at 1,298, while the S&P Index was up four to 743
The 30-year bond was up 10/32 to yield 6.49 pct as Wall Street opened.
